title: Prepare a practical container growing mix
subcategory: Prepare a practical container growing mix
summary: Use a light, clean, moisture-retentive but drainable medium.
steps: Start with labelled commercial potting mix or known clean components intended for containers.
Add mature compost in a moderate proportion rather than filling the container with compost alone.
Avoid dense clay soil, rubble, unknown fill and materials contaminated by chemicals or animal waste.
Moisten before planting and break dry clumps without crushing all pore space.
Replace or refresh mix when drainage collapses, disease persists or salt buildup cannot be corrected.
